justification: Panel A depicts a schematic line drawing of a long ship with an oared hull and small stick-like figures, executed in a thin monochrome outline style typical of engraved rock imagery. Panel B shows a weathered relief carving with dense, worn figural/geometric forms in high relief, but no boat, oars, or comparable linear composition is discernible; the two share no specific motifs, relationships, or arrangement, only the broad fact of being ancient decorated stone surfaces.
